BlazingClusterRogueExileSorceress1.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.

BurstShotIncendiaryBoltMonster.name: Incendiary Shot
BurstShotIncendiaryBoltMonster.description: Fire flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.

ChilledGroundOasisConvertWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Oasis

CombatFrenzyRogueExileHuntress1.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

CometRogueExileMonk2.name: Comet
CometRogueExileMonk2.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

ConvalescenceRogueExileWitch1.name: Convalescence

The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.

DisengageRogueExileHuntress1.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

EarthshatterRogueExileWarrior2.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

EscapeShotRogueExileRanger1.name: Escape Shot
EscapeShotRogueExileRanger1.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.

EssenceDrainRogueExileWitch2.name: Essence Drain
EssenceDrainRogueExileWitch2.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

ExecutionerChannelledSlam.name: Supercharged Slam
ExecutionerChannelledSlam.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

ExplosiveShotAmmoRogueExileMercenary1.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

ExplosiveShotRogueExileMercenary1.name: Explosive Shot
ExplosiveShotRogueExileMercenary1.description: Fire a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

ExplosiveSpearRogueExileHuntress2.name: Explosive Spear
ExplosiveSpearRogueExileHuntress2.description: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.

ExplosiveTeleportSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Deception
ExplosiveTeleportSandDjinn.description: Command Kelari to create a blast at the target location that deals Spell damage, and leave behind a clone that persists for a short duration. This skill can store multiple charges, and using it again while a clone from a previous use is still alive causes that clone to explode, dealing even more damage.

FireBombSkeletonMinion.name: Fire Bomb
FireBombSkeletonMinion.description: Attacks with a bouncing bomb that explodes on hit.

FireRuneFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Trap
FireRuneFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to hurl his greatsword, spreading hazardous runes on the ground where it lands. If an enemy steps on a rune, it erupts in a fiery tornado that deals Spell damage.

FireboltRogueExileSorceress2.name: Firebolt
FireboltRogueExileSorceress2.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

FirestormRogueExileSorceress1.name: Firestorm
FirestormRogueExileSorceress1.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.

FlameSliceFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Zealotry
FlameSliceFireDjinn.description: When you use a damaging Skill, Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies near your target with zealous fervour, inflicting Exposure.

FlameblastRogueExileSorceress2.name: Flameblast
FlameblastRogueExileSorceress2.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channel for.

FlammabilityRogueExileSorceress1.name: Flammability
FlammabilityRogueExileSorceress1.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Fire Resistance.

FlashGrenadeRogueExileMercenary1.name: Flash Grenade
FlashGrenadeRogueExileMercenary1.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.

FragmentationRoundsAmmoRogueExileMercena.name: Load Fragmentation Rounds
FragmentationRoundsAmmoRogueExileMercena.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.

FragmentationRoundsRogueExileMercenary1.name: Fragmentation Rounds
FragmentationRoundsRogueExileMercenary1.description: Fire Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of ice shards. These fragments can Merge.

FreezingSalvoRogueExileRanger1.name: Freezing Salvo
FreezingSalvoRogueExileRanger1.description: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.

FreezingShardsRogueExile.name: Freezing Shards
FreezingShardsRogueExile.description: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.

FrostBombExileMonk2.name: Frost Bomb
FrostBombExileMonk2.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.

FrostWallRogueExileMercenary2.name: Frost Wall
FrostWallRogueExileMercenary2.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.

FrostboltRogueExileSorceress2.name: Frostbolt
FrostboltRogueExileSorceress2.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

GSBoneOfferingExplosionMinion.name: Bone Explosion
GSBoneOfferingExplosionMinion.description: The minion's shield of bone explodes, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

GSBoneOfferingExplosionMinionSanguine.name: Bone Explosion
GSBoneOfferingExplosionMinionSanguine.description: The minion's shield of bone explodes, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

GaleStrikeExileMonk1.name: Wind Blast
GaleStrikeExileMonk1.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.

GasArrowRogueExileRanger2.name: Gas Arrow
GasArrowRogueExileRanger2.description: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.name: Gas Arrow
GasShotSkeletonSniperMinion.description: Rain an arrow down from above, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas where it lands. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

GatheringStormExileMonk1.name: Gathering Storm
GatheringStormExileMonk1.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

GlacialCascadeExileMonk1.name: Glacial Cascade
GlacialCascadeExileMonk1.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.

GoreChargerChargeIncursion.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

GreatHuntPackleaderMinion.name: Eternal Hunt
GreatHuntPackleaderMinion.description: The Azmerian Wolf howls, reaching out to the spirits to begin an Eternal Hunt. While the Eternal Hunt persists, spirits manifest as spectral wolves to ambush foes, damaging and Maiming enemies they Hit before disappearing.

HailstormRoundsAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.name: Load Hailstorm Rounds
HailstormRoundsAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

HailstormRoundsRogueExileMercenary2.name: Hailstorm Rounds
HailstormRoundsRogueExileMercenary2.description: Fire all loaded bolts into the sky, causing them to rain down over the target area, starting at the centre and spreading outward.

HammerOfTheGodsRogueExileWarrior1.name: Hammer of the Gods
HammerOfTheGodsRogueExileWarrior1.description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

HandOfChayulaRogueExileWitch2.name: Hand of Chayula
HandOfChayulaRogueExileWitch2.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.

HandSlamSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Judgment
HandSlamSandDjinn.description: Channel and Command Kelari to Channel alongside you, creating blades that hang over the target location. The longer you Channel, the more blades Kelari will create. Upon release, his blades plunge into the ground and create shockwaves that deal Spell damage.

HellscapeFleshFodderArc.name: Arc
HellscapeFleshFodderArc.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Shocked enemies Hit release damaging pulses.

HuhuGrubLarvaeMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

HusbandMonsterBlazingLance.name: Blazing Lance
HusbandMonsterBlazingLance.description: Throw a spear leaving a trail of Fire in its wake, Burning enemies. Then throws a second spear in the same direction, causing the trail of Fire to expand outwards.

IceArmourSkeletonMageMinion.name: Ice Armour
IceArmourSkeletonMageMinion.description: Command a Skeletal Frost Mage to target a location or Minion and apply Ice Armour to Minions in an area, reducing damage taken from Hits, causing damage to enemies that Hit them, and counting as Frozen for other effects.

IceNovaRogueExileRanger1.name: Ice Nova
IceNovaRogueExileRanger1.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

IceNovaRogueExileSorceress2.name: Ice Nova
IceNovaRogueExileSorceress2.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

IncinerateRogueExileSorceress1.name: Incinerate
IncinerateRogueExileSorceress1.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

IncursionDoctorBloodLightning.name: Ball Lightning
IncursionDoctorBloodLightning.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

KnifeThrowSandDjinn.name: Kelari's Brutality
KnifeThrowSandDjinn.description: Command Kelari to throw a volley of knives at the target location. The knives burrow into the ground, then erupt into the air after a short delay, dealing Spell damage.

LargeScarabBuff.name: Rallying Cry
LargeScarabBuff.description: Performs a warcry, granting increased damage and mana regeneration to the user and nearby allies if there are nearby enemies. The damage increase is proportional to the number of surrounding enemies. Shares a cooldown with other Warcry skills.

LeapSlamRogueExileWarrior1.name: Leap Slam
LeapSlamRogueExileWarrior1.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

LightlessStalkerGazePlayerMinion.name: [DNT] Dark Visions
LightlessStalkerGazePlayerMinion.description: DNT It looks at you menacingly

LightningBoltRogueExileSorceress2.name: Lightning Bolt
LightningBoltRogueExileSorceress2.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

LightningWarpRogueExileSorceress2.name: Lightning Warp
LightningWarpRogueExileSorceress2.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

LingeringIllusionRogueExileMonk2.name: Lingering Illusion
LingeringIllusionRogueExileMonk2.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.

LivingBombFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Brand
LivingBombFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to place a fiery brand on an enemy. After a delay or when Detonated, the brand explodes, dealing Spell damage to enemies caught in the blast.

LivingLightningZap.name: Living Bolt
LivingLightningZap.description: Teleport to a target, dealing Lightning Attack Damage.

MPSArchitectBossIceSpear.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

MapModElementalWeakness.name: Elemental Weakness
MapModElementalWeakness.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.

MapModEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
MapModEnfeeble.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

MapModTemporalChains.name: Temporal Chains
MapModTemporalChains.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

MarAcolyteThrowFire.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MarakethUndeadPriestRollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
MarakethUndeadPriestRollingMagma.description: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill Chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. The number of  Chains is refreshed when passing through a Flame Wall.

MassFusilladeFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Fury
MassFusilladeFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to conjure two volleys of flaming embers and fire them forward. The embers explode on impact, dealing Spell damage.

MastodonCharge.name: Shield Charge
MastodonCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

MastodonNecroMeteor.name: Comet
MastodonNecroMeteor.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

MeleeBowRogueExile.name: Bow Shot
MeleeBowRogueExile.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

MeleeCrossbowRogueExile.name: Crossbow Shot
MeleeCrossbowRogueExile.description: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

MeleeSpiderWebAttach.name: Ensnaring Arrow
MeleeSpiderWebAttach.description: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies always count as moving, and have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

MetaCastOnDodgeRogueExileMonk2.name: Cast on Dodge
MetaCastOnDodgeRogueExileMonk2.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

MeteorFireDjinn.name: Ruzhan's Reckoning
MeteorFireDjinn.description: Command Ruzhan to teleport to the target location. Upon arrival, the Djinn deals Spell damage to enemies around him then slams his blazing sword into the ground, creating a wave of lava that also deals Spell damage.

MonsterBurningArrow.name: Burning Arrow
MonsterBurningArrow.description: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

MonsterModShroudWalker.name: Smoke Mine
MonsterModShroudWalker.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

MonsterModShroudWalker2.name: Smoke Mine
MonsterModShroudWalker2.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

MonsterPuncture.name: Puncture
MonsterPuncture.description: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.

MonsterSplitArrow.name: Split Arrow
MonsterSplitArrow.description: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

MudBurrowerTrapAcidMortarSpraySpam.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

MutewindWomanWhirlingBlades.name: Whirling Blades
MutewindWomanWhirlingBlades.description: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. Only works with daggers, claws and one handed swords. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

OilGrenadeRogueExileMercenary1.name: Oil Grenade
OilGrenadeRogueExileMercenary1.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.

PainOfferingRogueExileWitch1.name: Pain Offering
PainOfferingRogueExileWitch1.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

PaleFrogShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
PaleFrogShieldCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

PassiveTriggeredManaWaveWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Calming
PassiveTriggeredManaWaveWaterDjinn.description: When you Command Navira to use a Skill, she also emits a restorative wave that grants you and any other Allies it touches increased Mana Regeneration for a short duration.

PlasmaBlastAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.name: Load Plasma Blast
PlasmaBlastAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.description: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.

PlasmaBlastRogueExileMercenary2.name: Plasma Blast
PlasmaBlastRogueExileMercenary2.description: Channel to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.

PlayerMonsterModShroudWalker.name: Smoke Mine
PlayerMonsterModShroudWalker.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

PlayerMonsterModShroudWalker2.name: Smoke Mine
PlayerMonsterModShroudWalker2.description: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

PoisonBurstArrowRogueExileRanger2.name: Poisonburst Arrow
PoisonBurstArrowRogueExileRanger2.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

ProfaneRitualRogueExileWitch2.name: Profane Ritual
ProfaneRitualRogueExileWitch2.description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.

QuadrillaShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
QuadrillaShieldCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

RagingSpiritsRogueExileSorceress1.name: Raging Spirits
RagingSpiritsRogueExileSorceress1.description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

RakeRogueExileHuntress2.name: Rake
RakeRogueExileHuntress2.description: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.

RamGiantWheelThrow.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

RapidAssaultRogueExileHuntress2.name: Rapid Assault
RapidAssaultRogueExileHuntress2.description: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

RapidShotAmmoRogueExileMercenary1.name: Load Rapid Shot
RapidShotAmmoRogueExileMercenary1.description: Load your Crossbow with a large clip of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire them, and reaching maximum Heat will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

RapidShotIncendiaryBoltMonster.name: Rapid Shot
RapidShotIncendiaryBoltMonster.description: Fire a stream of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire, and reaching maximum heat will prevent you from firing these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits.

RapidShotRogueExileMercenary1.name: Rapid Shot
RapidShotRogueExileMercenary1.description: Fire a stream of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire, and reaching maximum heat will prevent you from firing these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits.

RisenArbalestRainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows
RisenArbalestRainOfArrows.description: Fires a large number of arrows into the air, to land in an area around the target after a short delay. Consumes a Frenzy Charge on use to fire additional arrows.

RockSliderShieldCharge.name: Table Charge
RockSliderShieldCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

RollingSlamRogueExileWarrior1.name: Rolling Slam
RollingSlamRogueExileWarrior1.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

SacrificeRogueExileWitch2.name: Sacrifice
SacrificeRogueExileWitch2.description: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.

SeismicCryRogueExileWarrior2.name: Seismic Cry
SeismicCryRogueExileWarrior2.description: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

SerpentClanCurse.name: Vulnerability
SerpentClanCurse.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

SerpentClanCurseBoss.name: Vulnerability
SerpentClanCurseBoss.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

ShatteringPalmRogueExileMonk2.name: Shattering Palm
ShatteringPalmRogueExileMonk2.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.

ShatteringRoarSkeletalBruteMinion.name: Shattering Roar
ShatteringRoarSkeletalBruteMinion.description: Command a Skeletal Brute to use a Warcry, Intimidating nearby enemies and Consuming Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

ShellMonsterDeathMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

ShellMonsterDeathMortarPoison.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

ShellMonsterSprayMortar.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

ShellMonsterSprayMortarPoison.description: Generic monster mortar skill. Like Monster Projectile but has an impact effect.

ShieldBlockRogueExileWarrior2.name: Raise Shield
ShieldBlockRogueExileWarrior2.description: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

SiegeCascadeAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.name: Load Siege Cascade
SiegeCascadeAmmoRogueExileMercenary2.description: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

SiegeCascadeRogueExileMercenary2.name: Siege Cascade
SiegeCascadeRogueExileMercenary2.description: Aim skyward and fires an enemy-seeking payload which drops a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

SnakeHulkDualStrike.name: Dual Strike
SnakeHulkDualStrike.description: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

SnipeRogueExileRanger1.name: Snipe
SnipeRogueExileRanger1.description: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.

SolarOrbRogueExileSorceress2.name: Solar Orb
SolarOrbRogueExileSorceress2.description: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.

SparkRogueExileSorceress2.name: Spark
SparkRogueExileSorceress2.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

SpearOfSolarisRogueExileHuntress2.name: Spear of Solaris
SpearOfSolarisRogueExileHuntress2.description: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.

SpearfieldRogueExileHuntress1.name: Spearfield
SpearfieldRogueExileHuntress1.description: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.

StampedeRogueExileWarrior2.name: Stampede
StampedeRogueExileWarrior2.description: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of Attack speed.

StonebackRhoaTableCharge.name: Table Charge
StonebackRhoaTableCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

StormLanceRogueExileHuntress2.name: Storm Lance
StormLanceRogueExileHuntress2.description: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.

SummonBeastRogueExileHuntress2.name: Companion: {0}
SummonBeastRogueExileHuntress2.description: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

SummonSkeletalWarriorsRogueExileWitch1.name: Skeletal Warrior Minion
SummonSkeletalWarriorsRogueExileWitch1.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.

SummonSpectreRogueExileWitch1_1.name: Spectre: {0}
SummonSpectreRogueExileWitch1_1.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

SummonSpectreRogueExileWitch1_3.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

SummonSpectreRogueExileWitch2_1.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

SuperchargedSlamRogueExileWarrior1.name: Supercharged Slam
SuperchargedSlamRogueExileWarrior1.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

SwollenMillerChargeFar.name: Shield Charge
SwollenMillerChargeFar.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

TangmazuMadFlightMinion.name: Mad Flight
TangmazuMadFlightMinion.description: Command part of your flock to leave and crash through a set of illusory mirrors, Attacking enemies in the area between the mirrors with frequent Hits.

TemporalChainsRogueExileMonk2.name: Temporal Chains
TemporalChainsRogueExileMonk2.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

TemporalChainsRogueExileWitch2.name: Temporal Chains
TemporalChainsRogueExileWitch2.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

ThunderousLeapRogueExileHuntress2.name: Thunderous Leap
ThunderousLeapRogueExileHuntress2.description: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.

TombStalkerEarthquake.name: Earthquake
TombStalkerEarthquake.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

TombStalkerLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
TombStalkerLeapSlam.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

TornadoShotRogueExileRanger2.name: Tornado Shot
TornadoShotRogueExileRanger2.description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

ToxicGrowthRogueExileRanger2.name: Toxic Growth
ToxicGrowthRogueExileRanger2.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

TrailOfCaltropsRogueExileHuntress1.name: Trail of Caltrops
TrailOfCaltropsRogueExileHuntress1.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.

TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsRogueExileHuntre.name: Caltrops
TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsRogueExileHuntre.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.

TwisterRogueExileHuntress1.name: Twister
TwisterRogueExileHuntress1.description: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

UnearthRogueExileWitch1.name: Unearth
UnearthRogueExileWitch1.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

UnloadAmmoRogueExile.name: Basic Bolt
UnloadAmmoRogueExile.description: Clear your active Bolt and reload any ammunition.

VaalBloodPriestExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
VaalBloodPriestExsanguinate.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.

VaalConstructGolemLightningCharge.name: Table Charge
VaalConstructGolemLightningCharge.description: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

VaalStormcallerBallLightning.name: Ball Lightning
VaalStormcallerBallLightning.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

VaalZealotColdEyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
VaalZealotColdEyeOfWinter.description: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.

VaultingImpactExileMonk1.name: Vaulting Impact
VaultingImpactExileMonk1.description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

VineArrowRogueExileRanger2.name: Vine Arrow
VineArrowRogueExileRanger2.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.

WaterBubbleWaterDjinn.name: Navira's Embrace
WaterBubbleWaterDjinn.description: Command Navira to create a bubble shield which absorbs a portion of the damage dealt by enemies standing outside the shield. The maximum amount of damage that can be absorbed is based on your maximum Mana. If the shield is destroyed by damage, it collapses into a patch of Chilled Ground.

WeaponGrantedChaosboltRogueExileWitch2.name: Chaos Bolt
WeaponGrantedChaosboltRogueExileWitch2.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

WhirlingAssaultExileMonk1.name: Whirling Assault
WhirlingAssaultExileMonk1.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

WhirlingSlashRogueExileHuntress1.name: Whirling Slash
WhirlingSlashRogueExileHuntress1.description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.

WhirlwindLanceRogueExileHuntress1.name: Whirlwind Lance
WhirlwindLanceRogueExileHuntress1.description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

WindSerpentsFuryRogueExileHuntress1.name: Wind Serpent's Fury
WindSerpentsFuryRogueExileHuntress1.description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

WitheringPresenceRogueExileRanger2.name: Withering Presence
WitheringPresenceRogueExileRanger2.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

WolfLeapAttackMinion.name: Leap Slam
WolfLeapAttackMinion.description: Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way.
